 Order

The instant writ petition has been filed by the Petitioner seeking a direction upon the Respondents and more particularly to the Respondent No.6 to carry out the investigation in respect of Sonai P.S. Case No.49/2013 dated 17.03.2013 registered under Section 468/406/420 IPC against the accused persons within the time bound manner and also seeking a direction upon the Respondents to protect the life and property of the Petitioner and her family members.
2. The record reveals that on 01.09.2014, notice was issued making it returnable by 6 (six) weeks.

This Court also finds it relevant to take note of that on 24.07.2019, the Government Advocate had placed the status of the case before this Court on the basis of a communication issued by the Office of the Superintendent of Police, Cachar.

entities.text: Office of the Superintendent of Police,
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: From the said report, it reveals that certain investigation was carried out and during the investigation, it was found that the accused persons had mislead this Court by producing forged document and had Page No.# 4/5 obtained the stay order.
However, in spite of getting sufficient evidence, the investigation in respect to the said case is kept pending on account of the accused persons were not arrested.

Pursuant thereto, the accused persons who have been impleaded to the instant proceedings have been arrayed as Respondent Nos. 7 to 13 on the basis of an order dated 28.08.2019 in I.A.(Civil) No.2698/2019.
However, when the matter has been called today, neither the Petitioner nor the said Respondent Nos. 7 to 13 were represented.

3. It is also pertinent herein to take note of that on the last date, when the matter was listed i.e. on 30.09.2019, it was submitted on behalf of the learned counsel appearing for the private Respondents that a Criminal Revision Petition No.871/2013 was filed by the said Respondent Nos. 7 to 13 which was pending and accordingly, this Court had directed that the said Criminal Revision Petition No.871/2013 be listed before this Court along with the instant writ petition.

sentences.text: This Court have also perused the contents of the Criminal Revision Petition No.871/2013.

From a perusal of the said revision petition, it reveals that the Respondent Nos. 7 to 13 along with one Smti Usha Rani Suklabaidya had filed the said petition for quashing of the FIR in connection with G.R.
Case No.932/2013 pending before the CJM, Cachar, Silchar which arose out of Sonai P.S. Case No.49/2013.
It is further seen from the records of the Criminal Revision Petition No.871/2013 that there is no stay to the said investigation in respect to Sonai P.S. Case No.49/2013.

5. In view of the above facts and more particularly the report dated 11.06.2019 and there being no stay to the said investigation, this Court is curious to know as to why it has taken a decade for the purpose of completion of the said investigation.

This Court had also enquired with Ms. U. Das, the learned Additional Senior Government Advocate as to the status of the said Page No.# 5/5 Sonai P.S. Case No.49/2013 and she submits on instructions that the same is pending.
6.

Accordingly, this Court fixes this matter again on 22.11.2023 on which date Ms. U. Das, the learned Additional Senior Government Advocate shall obtain the instructions as to why the investigation in respect to the said case is still pending even after a decade and that too when sufficient evidence have already been found against the accused persons.
JUDGE
